mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) signals expanding economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite sustained upward movement in GDPC1.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in the CPIAUCSL index above 260 signals accelerating inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) despite CPIAUCSL exceeding 260, or CPIAUCSL growth reverses.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and sustained growth in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) signal an easing monetary cycle and expanding demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite both FEDFUNDS declining and GDPC1 rising, or either proxy reverses its trend.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market anticipates further easing.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS declining in a late-cycle expansion regime, or FEDFUNDS rises afterward.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the unemployment rate below 3.0% signals a strengthening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) despite UNRATE falling below 3.0, or UNRATE recovers.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the INDPRO index and decline in the federal funds rate signal a supply-driven expansion and monetary easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite both INDPRO rising and FEDFUNDS declining, or either proxy reverses.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime, a sustained monthly decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals improving labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite UNRATE falling below 3.5 in a high-unemployment regime, or UNRATE rises afterward.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in PAYEMS (number of employed persons) signals a robust labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite sustained growth in PAYEMS, or PAYEMS growth reverses.
